newly_authored_data.rationale: Existing datasets either not focused on love/affection, not in required languages (Bengali/English/Romanized Bengali), or have licensing complications. Newly authored examples ensure content relevance, language consistency, clear licensing, and quality control.
newly_authored_data.authoring_method: Manual creation based on common Bengali/English love and affection expressions
newly_authored_data.licensing: Created for NexusAI project, no external attribution required
newly_authored_data.quality_control: Manual review for grammar, naturalness, and cultural appropriateness

recommendations: Expand dataset to 1,000+ examples per language before training
Add response variations for each input to improve model diversity
Add multi-turn conversation examples for contextual understanding
Add negative examples where model should not respond with romantic affection
Consider licensing and adapting DRAL or RBE_Social_20000 if suitable examples exist
Do NOT use Chinese datasets (LoveConflict) - language mismatch
Do NOT use Russian datasets (Russian Romantic Dialogue) - language mismatch
Do NOT use clinical datasets (MediBeng) - context mismatch
Do NOT use technical datasets (OpenSLR) - context mismatch
